# R09-B2 P4-v4 Execution Request `authorities` 静态合同 v0.3

**状态**：draft；替代未批准的 v0.2，仅申请 root 静态 parser/validator tooling 与 stdlib CPU fixtures。历史 D005 v2 authority 模型、禁止范围和后续 Gate 均保持 v0.2；本版只冻结 host-Git TCB 与 verification semantic grammar。

`authorities` 精确为 `{d005_pair,identity_sha256}`。`d005_pair` 精确为 `{model,recurrent,ttt_fast_weight,verification,historical_source,historical_verifier,identity_sha256}`，`model="historical_d005_v2"`。三 artifact binding 为 `{relative_path,sha256}`；`historical_source` 为 `{root_revision,gitlink_revision,submodule_revision,identity_sha256}`；`historical_verifier` 为 `{relative_path,root_revision,git_blob_sha256,identity_sha256}`。所有摘要/revision/identity、历史固定 artifact bytes、historical source tuple、verifier relative path和 blob bytes SHA均与 v0.2 精确相同；历史 tuple 有意不等于 current request source。

三 artifact 为固定历史 raw：`recurrent.json`=`2d04c5040c5836249bcab78e7904c2cf8a475c4fcf5925942ebb496985cd3190`，`ttt_fast_weight.json`=`8890bbec61a808d5964657806cf01166c893ff66abc2fdf64ea3cd201a03274e`，`verification.json`=`8618488f9c8cbbcdda2ea9d513f1f76a0154798fe386ce19dcbeac78fcff4080`，路径均在 `artifacts/g0/r09/b2/p4_launch_d005/`。历史 root revision=`ddb4e0eae97fb545d5239c1ddb6d4387170f3780`，Gitlink/submodule=`21d064f2b7c7aeeb67cfee50ac8d6722a944eddb`；historical verifier 为 `tools/g0/verify_r09_b2_p4_d005.py`，Git blob bytes SHA256=`2c94f28a7779f7e74a2798124a0d85e57bafa8aab739b6072ef6790a91c9a4e6`。

显式接口为 `validate_authorities_pair(authorities: object, request: dict[str, object], root: Path, git_executable: Path) -> None`。`root` 必是已经 source section 验证的 `request.source.root` absolute canonical root；`git_executable` 必是已经 interpreter section `validate_host_git()` 和 `validate_interpreter()` 验证通过的 `request.interpreter.host_git.path` 的同一 absolute non-symlink path。唯一允许的 historical blob lookup argv 是 `[str(git_executable), "-C", str(root), "show", f"{historical_revision}:{historical_verifier_relative_path}"]`；拒绝 bare `git`、PATH/which/shell/fallback/self-verification、不同 host Git 或不同 `-C` root。blob raw SHA 必等于 binding；host-Git/PATH shadow/argv drift 永久 FAIL。

每个 artifact path 必 root-relative、非空、无 `..`、非绝对且两两不同；拼接后 strict-resolved、non-symlink、`is_relative_to(root)`、`fstat` regular。只允许 `O_RDONLY|O_NOFOLLOW|O_CLOEXEC` single-fd/single-raw；exact raw 供 SHA，禁止 pathname reopen。records raw 必 canonical JSON；历史 pretty-printed verification raw 只做 exact SHA byte binding，随后解码对象以如下固定 semantic grammar比较，绝不重写证据。

historical verification object 精确为：顶层 keys=`{checks,schema_version,status}`；`schema_version="r09_b2_p4_d005_verifier_v2"`；`status="PASS"`；`checks` keys=`{distinct_outputs,matched,recurrent,ttt_fast_weight}`；`distinct_outputs` 为 `true`；`matched` keys=`{budget,external_assets,p1_manifest,p3_sha256,source}`且全为 `true`；每个 backend object keys=`{argv,budget,command_digest,cwd,env_assets_bound,environment,inputs,non_executable,outputs,record_digest,schema,source}`且全为 `true`。任何 added/missing/retyped/false key/value 均 FAIL。records 的 backend、schema/status、`d005_sha256` self digest、historical source tuple也必须精确相符；不得调用 ambient/current `verify_pair()` 或 `validate_environment_pair()` 验证历史 v2 evidence。

current request 仅通过已关闭 environment grammar连接：authority validator 复用其冻结 projection/object/P3 mapping，对 fd-bound historical records重算 expected projection，要求 current environment 两 backend 的 `d005_projection`、effective/native和 P3值精确相等；不 materialize历史 `IMAGINAIRE_OUTPUT_ROOT`/`PYTHONPATH`。不维护第二份 allowlist/P3 mapping。

CPU fixtures：anchor 正例；artifact/source/verifier binding identity/path/sha/revision/blob/host-git argv/PATH shadow drift；regular/no-follow/TOCTOU；record canonical/backend/schema/status/self digest drift；verification raw pretty bytes binding、每一层 top/checks/matched/backend added/missing/false/non-bool drift；record swap/duplicate path；environment projection/effective/native/P3 drift；ambient `os.environ` shadow 不影响结论。每个 intended branch 重算非目标摘要；除已验证 host Git 的固定 object lookup外禁止 subprocess/project execution、network、torch、GPU 与真实 staging。

本设计请求 `APPROVE_TO_IMPLEMENT_P4_V4_EXECUTION_REQUEST_AUTHORITIES_STATIC_TOOLS`。批准后仅实现 root static validator/fixtures并独立重审；current-source D005 refreeze、run/candidates/backends及真实 execution request仍须独立 Gate，真实 preflight/staging/P5/GPU/训练仍禁止。
